extensionDescription.message: Automatically rejects cookie consent banners so you never have to click them again.
extensionDescription.description: Add-on description in the Add-ons Manager and on addons.mozilla.org.

permissionWarning.message: Cookie Pookie needs access to all websites to reject their cookie banners.
permissionWarning.description: Popup warning when Firefox hasn't granted access to all websites.

enabledLabel.description: Label of the switch that turns Cookie Pookie on or off everywhere.

siteLabel.description: Label of the per-site switch. $HOST$ is shown in bold: a site name such as example.com, or the thisPage message.

thisPage.description: Stands in for the site name in siteLabel on pages that aren't websites.

statusNone.message: No cookie banner handled on this page.
statusNone.description: Popup status when nothing was handled on the current page.

statusRejected.description: Popup status after rejecting a banner. $CMP$ is the consent platform's name, such as Onetrust.

statusHidden.message: Hid the $CMP$ banner (it had no reject option).
statusHidden.description: Popup status after hiding a banner that had no reject button. $CMP$ is the consent platform's name.

total_one.description: Banners handled since install, for numbers in the 'one' plural category (e.g. 1). $COUNT$ is the number.

total_other.description: Banners handled since install, for all other numbers. Add total_few, total_many etc. for languages that need them.

reloadNote.message: Switch changes apply when you reload the page.

reportButton.description: Button that opens a pre-filled GitHub issue about the current site.

manageSites.description: Popup link that opens the options page with the sites where Cookie Pookie is off.

optionsHeading.message: Sites where Cookie Pookie is off

optionsEmpty.message: Cookie Pookie is on for every site. To turn it off for one, open the Cookie Pookie popup on that site.
optionsEmpty.description: Options page text when Cookie Pookie isn't turned off anywhere.

optionsTurnOn.description: Button next to each site on the options page.

optionsTurnOnLabel.message: Turn Cookie Pookie back on for $HOST$
optionsTurnOnLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the optionsTurnOn button. $HOST$ is the site, such as example.com.

optionsReloadNote.message: Changes apply to a site the next time you load it.
optionsReloadNote.description: Note at the bottom of the options page.
